- Home Oasis – Live at Manchester City Stadium
Oasis – Live at Manchester City Stadium
Contains some strong language and flashing images.
Oasis, one of the world's biggest touring bands, pulls out all the stops on their 2005 world tour. They return to Manchester for a triumphant concert at the City of Manchester Stadium.
